known_limits: Production lifecycle -> webhook enqueue wiring is an explicit P17/P19 composition seam (P2-3 resolution): EnqueueLifecycleEvent/EnqueueEvent/MarkDecommissioned are public and armed (dispatcher pump + at-least-once + forward-delete durable events + node decommission bounded best-effort DROPPED_DUE_TO_DECOMMISSION verified by tests), but no P14/P15 lifecycle file was edited in P16; the controller/agent sites that emit live lifecycle events to the queue are wired in later composition.
